name: update_notice_shot
description:
Photographs the update notice. NEEDS --keep-dialogs, or the guard refuses the window at Add and the screenshot is a plain colony -- the runner names the dropped window when that happens. Raises it through RaiseWindow rather than letting the real UIRoot_Entry.Init postfix do it, because a window raised at the main menu is discarded when UIRoot_Play takes over and no flag can change that; Dialog_UpdateNotice's parameterless constructor reads the same live settings the real path does, so the frame shows the real thing.

ONLY AN UPGRADING INSTALL EVER SEES THIS WINDOW -- a first run is seeded and shown nothing -- so the two states worth shooting are the two ROW combinations, and WHICH ONE IS SHOT IS DECIDED BY THE SETTINGS FILE, not by this scenario, since the notice reads persisted state. <vectorLights>False</vectorLights> plus no <updateNoticeVersion> gives the offer plus the cloud announcement; <vectorLights>True</vectorLights> hides the offer row and leaves the cloud announcement alone, which is the case the window height has to shrink for. Waits in FRAMES, not ticks -- a forcePause modal stops the clock, so a tick-based wait would hang here.

THE FIRST SCREENSHOT IS DELIBERATELY THROWN AWAY. hideUi is honoured from the second capture onwards, so a single-capture run photographs the colonist bar, the alert stack and the dev toolbar alongside the window. screenshotMode does not touch the window stack, so the dialog itself survives the hide -- only the game's own chrome goes.
